data_policy.anchor_deposit_stress: Trailing 24-hour deposit-stock deterioration; first 24 hours unavailable.
data_policy.holder_concentration: Observed top-10/top-100 Anchor depositor shares through 2022-05-06T23:00:00Z; unavailable rather than forward-filled after coverage ends.
data_policy.lfg_intervention: UNAVAILABLE as an observed peg-defense channel and excluded
data_policy.missing_features: Excluded at that timestamp; remaining weights renormalized to one.
data_policy.normalization: Backward-looking only; no future-window or full-sample normalization.

feature_policies.anchor_deposit_stress: clip(max(0, -pct_change(anchor_total_deposits, 24h)) / 0.10, 0, 1); uses only t and t-24h
feature_policies.holder_concentration: mean(clip((top10_anchor_share-0.10)/0.15, 0, 1), clip((top100_anchor_share-0.30)/0.30, 0, 1)); unavailable if either source is unavailable

cutoff_safe.interpretation: Each score uses only observations timestamped at or before that hour; weights are predeclared.

future_perturbation.rule: Perturbing every observation after a cutoff must not change any score or component at/before it.

cutoff_safe.objective: Leakage-safe monitoring score with fixed weights and availability normalization.
